scope: Native browser link reply admission, retained-loop error routing, and bounded Qwen intent diagnostics
policy: macOS MCP/native tools first; CU models only for demonstrated capability gaps.
Planner/context/intent/completion defects do not establish native incapability.
One build/test/inference at a time; no source edits while those operations run.
No model selection change, model download, live purchase, message or installed-app replacement.
findings: Native link lookup previously returned nil for invalid/truncated/error replies; attribute failures were skipped. The browser loop interprets nil as permission to request a visual proposal.

Strict shared native reply decoders now reject failed, truncated, malformed and mismatched-identity replies. Missing fields cannot masquerade as explicit unavailable attributes. Valid replies retain the existing exact destination verification.
A limited native search may still supply a verified matching link. Without a matching link, incomplete discovery reports incomplete evidence instead of claiming the tools lack the capability.

The initial executed RED has two failing decoder methods and one passing valid-reply method. The first GREEN attempt fails compilation because the new test omitted trustedUserPrompt. Subsequent fixture failures first report cleanup of a missing root, then requiredToolsMissing; creating the fixture root and including the load-required Mail tool resolves setup. No Mail tool is dispatched.

The five-case retained browser loop passes: lookup failure, attribute failure and limited no-match stop with zero visual proposals; the valid link navigates once; explicit AXURL unavailability reaches exactly one rejecting visual callback. No model inference is run in this injected test.

Final nine-method batch passes without skips. The actual default host/Apple planner/installed MCP helper workflow completes in 13.808 seconds, visits each of two pages once, and observes zero installs, model launches or workers. Existing main-thread responsiveness warning remains.

Qwen assessment-before-kind replay fails: a purchase remains undone despite answer; return proposes vision based on invented account requirements; information-only SFJAZZ prose wrongly associates the showtime condition with the 48-hour return deadline. Regex matches alone concealed that association error.

Goal-only Qwen intent initially matches 12 frozen flat labels, then fails the eighth fresh heldout (clarification before search). Revised outcome-based instructions match all unchanged 32 flat goals. The first typed clarification case then incorrectly classifies searching after a destination answer as requiresChange. No classifier is promoted.
Intent category is not action authorization, proof that a condition holds, remaining-work tracking or task completion. Typed clarification context and user authority remain requirements.

qwenIntent.tested: Five new bounded runs; semantic failures retained

generalProduction.tested: Public whole-goal, normal HostSession/provider/phone and mixed/native acceptance remain open
